fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Gross Revenue (includes self-service laundry, drop-off, pickup/delivery, and Wash-Dry-Fold). An additional Mobile Support Fee of 4% of Mobile Gross Revenue applies (minimum $300/month) if franchisee offers Mobile Services. National Advertising Fund is up to 1% of Gross Revenue but is not currently being implemented. Local Marketing minimum is $500/month starting in month 7 of operation. An additional $500/month Mobile Local Marketing minimum applies if the mobile option is added. Grand Opening Marketing requires a one-time $20,000 payment before opening. POS and Payment Systems fees vary: Wash Dry Fold POS initial cost $4,199 plus $85/month (Year 1) or $115/month (after Year 1); Cents initial cost $2,805 plus $215–$395/month; LaundroWorks $25–$155/month; LaundryPay $2,000/year. Late fee is 10% per annum plus $500 administrative fee. Transfer fee is $5,000 plus 10% broker commission (minimum $20,000). Renewal fee is $5,000. Retraining is $300 per person per day.
